subject: Request: sandbox top-up & trial extension — Storly integration delay
messages:
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@storly.io>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sandbox top-up & trial extension — Storly integration delay

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from the engineering side — we hit an unexpected API contract change in a third-party dependency yesterday that has blocked the connector work. Our devs estimate ~10 business days to rework the adapter and finish end-to-end tests. That pushes our originally planned launch window and we're worried the current sandbox allocation and trial window won't cover the next round of verification.

Is there flexibility to extend the trial window and add a modest sandbox top-up so we can finish validation without losing momentum? If it helps, I can share the integration logs and a short timeline.

We really like Redwood’s latency and routing behavior so far; just need this little runway to complete the adapter.

Thanks —
Alex Wong
Head of Integrations, Storly
alex.wong@storly.io
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: storly_integration_issue_log.txt (text)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@storly.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sandbox top-up & trial extension — Storly integration delay

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the log. I pulled the engineering notes and talked to CS about options. We can do the following to keep your pilot on track:

- 21-day trial extension on the current account
- One-time sandbox top-up: 50k token-equivalent credit for staging/testing

Conditions: we need a short approval email from your procurement/contact who owns purchases (name + approval line or a PO) and a date by which you expect to resume normal testing. Once we have that, I’ll route the top-up immediately — Marissa (cc) will handle the provisioning. Ben (cc) can help with any contractual language if your procurement needs a short amendment.

If you prefer, I can issue the extension and top-up now on our side and we’ll formalize the PO afterward — I just want to make sure we’re aligned on the approval path.

Next steps suggested:
1) Reply with approver name + short approval note (or PO)
2) Marissa will post the credit and update the HubSpot deal
3) Ben to provide a one-paragraph amendment if needed

I’m keeping this limited so we don’t accidentally extend beyond what you need. Happy to set up a 15-min call if you want to walk the team through the plan.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@storly.io>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sandbox top-up & trial extension — Storly integration delay

Thanks Lauren — much appreciated.

Approver: Mei Tan (Head of Procurement) — mei.tan@storly.io. Mei has asked for a brief note that this is a one-time development sandbox top-up tied to an integration delay and is non-billable until after a signed commitment. I’ll ask her to reply directly with the approval/PO.

One more ask: does Redwood have an SOC 2 evidence packet or a short security checklist we can share with our security reviewers while the engineers finish validation? If procurement needs to escalate, having that on hand speeds things up.

I’ve also attached the issue log you requested earlier and an estimated dev timeline: we expect the connector changes to be merged and smoke-tested by Oct 4, 2027.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

—Alex
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@storly.io>, Mei Tan <mei.tan@storly.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sandbox top-up & trial extension — Storly integration delay

Hi Alex / Mei — looping Mei in per Alex's note.

Mei — nice to meet you. Quick summary and confirmation from Redwood:
- One-time 50k token-equivalent sandbox credit, applied to Storly staging account upon written approval
- 21-day trial window extension starting today (9/22/2027)
- This is non-billable while in the trial/validation phase; if Storly converts to a paid contract we’ll reconcile the usage per the agreed terms

Attached: runway-supplement-proposal.pdf (internal summary) and approval_signature_stub.txt (short form indicating we will provision on receipt of the approval email). Marissa — can you provision the credit and update the HubSpot deal (D-83742) once we have Mei's reply? Ben — attaching a one-paragraph amendment you can send to procurement if they need formal language.

Separately Mei, we do have a brief SOC2 + compliance packet we can share. I’ll ask our security team to send the standard SOC2 overview doc within the hour and Marissa will attach it to the HubSpot record.

If either of you want a 15-min handoff with our CS/eng team to align on smoke-test criteria, I can schedule that for tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Storly back on track.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: runway-supplement-proposal.pdf (pdf), approval_signature_stub.txt (text)
